description: Plaatselijke hoofdstukken en bestaande beelden gelezen en bekeken; nieuwe resultaten gecontroleerd op inhoud, anatomie en leesbaarheid.

images.alt: Vergelijking: de dorsende os — 1 Korinthiërs 9:9; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Illustrate the scriptural comparison quoted in 1 Corinthians 9:9–10: an ox treading grain on an ancient open-air threshing floor. One healthy anatomically correct ox with four legs walks across sheaves on the circular earthen threshing surface. Its mouth is free with no muzzle, it may eat some grain. A modestly clothed adult farm worker stands safely to one side. No plough, no modern machine, no yoke pulling machinery, no whip or injury. The ox illustrates the quoted teaching about a worker sharing in the harvest; not a new event in Paul’s life.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: velen delen één brood — 1 Korinthiërs 10:17; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Illustrate 1 Corinthians 10:16–17, one loaf shared by many as a sign of one body. A simple first-century household gathering of five adult believers around a low wooden table, central adult man gently breaks one large single round loaf into portions, other adults reach only with clearly distinct hands. One plain cup on the table. Quiet worship, not a reconstruction of the Last Supper, no Jesus portrait and no modern chalice. Focus on the single loaf and sharing.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: eten kopen op de markt — 1 Korinthiërs 10:25; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Illustrate the practical example of 1 Corinthians 10:25: an ordinary adult believer purchases food from a first-century market stall without interrogating the seller about its origin. A seller with a small selection of cooked meat and vegetables on pottery trays, a modestly dressed buyer paying a few coins. No blood, carcass, sacrifice, idol worship or modern signage. Roman Mediterranean town market, exactly two main adults, simple clear hands. This is a teaching example, not a named historical episode.

rows: Niet alles wat toegestaan is, is nuttig.

rows: Paulus noemt dit toestemming, geen bevel.
